name: install_local
title: Install a package from a local file

origin.description: Install one or more packages from a local directory or source tarball.
origin.usage: install_local(path = ".", subdir = NULL, dependencies = NA, upgrade = c("default", "ask", "always", "never"), force = FALSE, quiet = FALSE, build = !is_binary_pkg(path), ..., lib)

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: A local directory or source tarball. The default is the working directory. Several paths are installed in order.

arguments.name: dependencies
arguments.text: Which dependencies to install. FALSE installs none.

arguments.name: upgrade
arguments.text: When to upgrade dependencies. never does not upgrade a package that is already installed.

arguments.name: quiet
arguments.text: When TRUE, captured install output is not shown. R CMD INSTALL has no quiet flag.

arguments.name: build
arguments.text: When TRUE, run R CMD build before R CMD INSTALL. A directory of a source package can be installed with build = FALSE.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: The path is copied, RemoteType local is written into DESCRIPTION, and the copy is installed with R CMD INSTALL. A temp library that is not on .libPaths() is installed again on the next call.
origin.value: The package name, or a character vector of names when path has several elements.
origin.example: install_local(pkg, dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, build = FALSE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Install one or more packages from a local directory or source tarball.
translation.usage: install_local(path='.', subdir=None, dependencies=NA, upgrade='default', force=False, quiet=False, build=None, lib=None)

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: A local directory or source tarball, or a list of them.

arguments.name: upgrade
arguments.text: never leaves an already installed dependency alone.

arguments.name: build
arguments.text: FALSE installs the directory with R CMD INSTALL and does not run R CMD build.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: The bundle is downloaded with urllib and installed with R CMD INSTALL into lib. A check uses a fresh temporary library and does not write to ~/R/library. RemoteType local and RemoteUrl, the real path, are written into DESCRIPTION.
translation.example: install_local(pkg, dependencies=False, upgrade="never", quiet=True, build=False, lib=lib)
